message.content: {"question":"Consider the matrices A = (1, 0, 3) and B = (b₁, b₂, b₃). Find the correct statement.","options":{"A":"A·B is symmetric if and only if (b₁, b₂, b₃) ∈ ℝ³ is not parallel to (1, 0, 3) ∈ ℝ³","B":"A·B is symmetric for any (b₁, b₂, b₃) ∈ ℝ³","C":"There does not exist (b₁, b₂, b₃) ∈ ℝ³ such that A·B is symmetric","D":"A·B is symmetric if and only if (b₁, b₂, b₃) ∈ ℝ³ is parallel to (1, 0, 3) ∈ ℝ³"},"correct":"D"}
